name: Drive-thru coffee
summary: Drive-thru-only coffee kiosk (≈500–1,000 SF, often modular or prefabricated) on a 0.2–1 acre pad with double stacking lanes. Site work (lanes, utilities, storm, curb cuts) is 40–55% of construction, so cost per SF of building is extreme and per-site budgeting is the right basis. Data are good: four 2026 franchise disclosure documents (Scooter's, 7 Brew, The Human Bean, Ziggi's) publish building and site ranges, cross-checked with one contractor guide.

typicalSize.method: One kiosk per project is the norm; multi-site programs are budgeted per site.

sfPerPrimaryUnit.method: Building SF per site: 7 Brew modular 510 SF (c2); Scooter's kiosk 650–700 SF (c1); Ziggi's drive-thru 500–865 SF (c4); Human Bean 14–16 ft × 40–50 ft = 560–800 SF (c3); contractor guide 950–1,200 SF for a drive-thru-only shop (c5). Mid 650 SF.

primaryUnitsPerAcre.method: 7 Brew lot 'ranging from 8,000 to 50,000 square feet' (c2) → 0.18–1.15 acre per site; typical outparcel ≈ 0.5 ac → 2 sites/acre equivalent.

parkingPerPrimaryUnit.method: Drive-thru-only formats need only staff and walk-up parking (judgment: 3–10 stalls); stacking lanes carried in site work.

perPrimaryUnit.method: Building + site work per site (excl. equipment, signs, POS). Scooter's site & building improvements $725,200–$772,000 (c1); 7 Brew building $305–650k + site $200–800k (+ freight/install up to $60k) = $505k–$1.51M (c2); Human Bean new construction $710k–$1.295M less ≥$131k equipment and $23.5–72k signs ≈ $0.56–1.09M (c3); Ziggi's building + site up to $1.0M (c4); contractor guide building $360–630k + site $80–200k = $440–830k (c5, includes some equipment). Mid $775k ≈ median of midpoints (Scooter's 749k, 7 Brew 1.0M, Human Bean 0.82M, Terrapin 0.64M). Low/high trimmed from the extremes.

perSF.method: perPrimaryUnit ÷ sfPerPrimaryUnit: $775k / 650 SF ≈ $1,190/SF; $500k / 700 ≈ $715; $1.25M / 700 ≈ $1,790. Site work inflates $/SF; building-only cost is $375–525/SF per c5.

scope.notes: Building (site-built or modular, incl. delivery/set) plus on-site work (dual drive lanes, bypass lane, utilities, storm, landscaping, lighting). Excludes espresso/refrigeration equipment, signs and menu boards, POS/drive-thru technology (see ffe), land, soft costs, impact/tap fees and off-site work.

qualityTiers.method: low/mid ($500k/$775k ≈ 0.65, rounded 0.7) and high/mid ($1.25M/$775k ≈ 1.6); premium = 7 Brew hurricane-rated / larger-site upper range.

systemSplit.method: Site share 0.42 = blend of 7 Brew site vs building midpoints (500k / 978k = 51%, c2) and contractor guide (140k / 635k = 22%, c5), weighted toward the franchisor data. Building 0.58 spread with a small-restaurant pattern; Div 13 holds modular/prefab building premium. Not from a published elemental estimate.

lineItems.name: Site work (dual drive lanes, utilities, storm, lighting, landscaping)

cost.method: 7 Brew site development $200,000–$800,000 (c2); Ziggi's site work up to $500,000 (c4); contractor guide $80,000–$200,000 (c5). Mid ≈ median of midpoints (500k, 250k, 140k) → ~$325k blended.

lineItems.notes: Carve-out of the baseline; varies most with utility distance and storm-water requirements.

lineItems.name: Modular building freight and installation

cost.method: 7 Brew: freight 'can range up to $30,000 per building' and installation 'up to $30,000 per building', in addition to Item 7 ranges (c2). High = 60k; mid ≈ 35k assumed.

lineItems.notes: Only for factory-built kiosks; not in 7 Brew's own Item 7 range.

lineItems.name: Site concept plan, site investigation report and energy consultant

cost.method: Scooter's: site investigation report 'approximately $5,000 per Kiosk Store' and energy consultant 'approximately $2,500 per Kiosk Store' (c1) → $7.5k; high allows Phase I ESA/traffic study.

perPrimaryUnit.method: Equipment + signs + POS/drive-thru tech per site: Scooter's $268,750–$290,700 (c1); 7 Brew $220,000–$320,000 (c2); Ziggi's $377,500–$438,000 (c4); Human Bean ≥$131k equipment + $23.5–72k signs ≈ $155–200k+ (c3). Mid $290k ≈ median.

pctOfHard.method: Scooter's A&E $46,700–$56,500 on ~$750k (6–7.5%, c1); 7 Brew A&E $10–60k + permits $2.5–25k (c2); Ziggi's A&E $55–90k + fees/permits up to $50.5k (to $100k if land is purchased/developed) on ≤$1.0M (c4); contractor guide 8–12% for A&E and permitting (c5). Add legal, survey, testing → mid 11%.

softCosts.notes: Type-specific: initial franchise fee $35,000–$40,000 (Human Bean $35k; Scooter's/Ziggi's $40k) plus launch/opening-support fees ($10k–$20k); 7 Brew requires a $125,000 development fee for a 10-store commitment. Not included in pctOfHard.

design.method: Standardized prototype/modular building limits design risk; judgment.

hard.method: Site work is the volatile half of the budget (soils, utilities, storm) — mirrors QSR norm of 10–15% project contingency (see retail-pad-qsr.json#e10).

perPrimaryUnit.method: Hard $500k–1.25M × (1.07–1.16 soft); min allows pad-ready sites (c5 all-in $550–950k incl. soft), max allows coastal/hurricane-rated modular on raw land (c2 high end).

source.title: Scooter's Coffee, LLC Franchise Disclosure Document (Scooter's 2026 FDD, issued April 3, 2026), Item 7 — Kiosk
source.publisher: Scooter's Coffee, LLC (hosted by Restaurant Finance Monitor)

evidence.scopeNotes: Building + site work. Same table: A&E $46,700–$56,500; equipment $181,750–$191,300; signs $52,500–$58,400; technology $34,500–$41,000; SIR ~$5,000; energy consultant ~$2,500.

source.publisher: Brew Culture Franchise, LLC (7 BREW) (hosted by Restaurant Finance Monitor)

evidence.scopeNotes: Summed by us. Building includes modular building and related signage; freight up to $30k and installation up to $30k are additional; excludes impact fees. Lot 8,000–50,000 SF. A&E $10–60k; equipment $185–250k; POS $25–30k; signs $10–40k.

source.title: The Human Bean Franchise Disclosure Document (issued February 25, 2026, amended May 5, 2026), Item 7 note 7
source.publisher: Casey Hawkins, Inc. (The Human Bean) (hosted by Restaurant Finance Monitor)

evidence.quote: For new construction the estimated range is from $710,000 to $1,295,000. This includes at least $605,700 to $1,188,700 for a new building, site improvements, awnings, signage, furniture, fixtures, equipment, etc.
evidence.scopeNotes: Includes FF&E (≥$131,000 equipment) and signs ($23,500–$72,000); structure 14'–16' wide × 40'–50' long. We net out equipment/signs for the hard-cost comparison.

source.publisher: Ziggi's Coffee Franchise, LLC (hosted by Restaurant Finance Monitor)

evidence.scopeNotes: Low end $0 = build-to-suit lease where landlord pays. Freestanding building ~500–865 SF. Equipment package incl. POS $325–375k; sign package $45–55k.

source.title: Average Cost to Build a QSR Coffee Shop from the Ground Up in the USA (2026): Drive-Thru, With Seating, and By Region

evidence.quote: Site work — the piece most developers underestimate on this format — adds $80,000 to $200,000 … a realistic all-in project cost, excluding land, of $550,000 to $950,000.
evidence.scopeNotes: Building hard cost $375–525/SF for 950–1,200 SF (building $360–630k), includes kitchen equipment/FF&E; soft costs 8–12% of hard. Contractor marketing content; components do not sum exactly to the all-in total.

openQuestions: Item 7 ranges are franchisor estimates, not closed-out costs; a few public site-plan or permit valuations for Dutch Bros / 7 Brew kiosks would validate the per-site mid.
Split between modular building cost and site-built kiosk cost is not separated in most FDDs.
Division split is derived; no elemental breakdown found.
